objective: Package calix-daemon and its per-user service in the Arch package, make the package build reproducible with the required Zig 0.16 toolchain, and validate the produced package from a clean source checkout.
scope: the user service runs the unprivileged daemon with a private runtime directory and conservative hardening
the GitHub release artifact contains the daemon, symlink and service
make package selects vendor/zig-0.16 and exports ZIG
PKGBUILD-calix rejects Zig versions other than 0.16.x with an actionable error
README, CONTRIBUTING and MANUAL_TESTING document package and service verification

container.retry_reason: The first replay exhausted the 16 GiB /tmp tmpfs during cargo test; the retry used TMPDIR=/var/tmp/calix-ci-replay on the host filesystem.

package_build.source: clean local clone at commit ee241502, source rewritten to file:// for the validation build
package_build.nonfatal_noise: libfakeroot internal error: payload not recognized! appeared after stripping; makepkg still exited 0 and the package manifest and extracted binaries were validated.

package_smoke.note: The package was extracted into a temporary root and the daemon ran from that extraction; it was not installed with pacman.

zig_override.system_zig_build_gate: rejected with exit 1 and an actionable message

static_checks.service_syntax: pass with ExecStart substituted with /bin/true because the install path is only present after package extraction

package_artifact.reason: Large build artifact; repository policy forbids committing packages. The SHA-256 and manifest are retained in evidence.

known_gaps: The package was not installed with pacman: installation and the live systemctl --user service check require an interactive pkexec/polkit session and were not run unattended.
The package service was syntax-checked and its extracted binary was smoke-tested, but systemd did not supervise the process in this run.
The clean package source was a local clone at the same commit rather than the remote URL; the committed tree is identical.
The first ci-replay attempt failed because /tmp was full; the successful retry used a host-filesystem TMPDIR and is the authoritative replay.
GitHub Actions was not triggered by this commit; the container replay remains the pre-push proof.
not_run: pacman -U package installation on the host
systemctl --user enable --now calix-daemon.service under a live desktop session
